HEARTSHAKE-ENABLEHEARTSHAKE.title: Enable heartbeat shake / 启用心跳震动
HEARTSHAKE-ENABLEHEARTSHAKE.hover.desc: When enabled: the Act4Heart Corrupt Heart fight plays the StS1 heartbeat screen pulse (weak shake + sound) every 1.33s until the heart dies. / 启用后: Act4Heart 尖塔之心战斗中还原一代心跳屏幕脉冲 (弱震动+音效), 每 1.33 秒一次, 直到心脏死亡.
HEARTSHAKE-ENABLEHEARTSOUND.title: Enable heartbeat sound / 启用心跳音效
HEARTSHAKE-ENABLEHEARTSOUND.hover.desc: Play the original StS1 heartbeat sound (SLS_SFX_HeartBeat_Simple) with each pulse. Volume follows your SFX volume. / 每次脉冲播放一代原版心跳音效 (SLS_SFX_HeartBeat_Simple), 音量跟随游戏音效设置.
